title: Why your data is worth more than your salary

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Your data predicts markets, behaviors, and trends—far more accurately than any salary ever could. (3 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Your salary is a fixed number, but your data is a dynamic asset that evolves with every click, search, and interaction. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Companies use your data to optimize products, personalize ads, and even influence policy—tools no salary can match. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Your salary funds your life, but your data is leveraged to shape the future—without your consent or compensation. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Your data isn’t just valuable—it’s the new currency, and you’re not getting paid for it. (4 sec)
